name: Cape Cornwall / The Brisons
ground: rough ground between headland and Brisons; smoother towards Gwenver/Sennen (search-snippet paraphrase of a guide)
depth: Cape Cornwall Bank rises to 25 m from 40 m seabed; ledges 30-36 m with sand gullies (DIV, dive report). Bann Shoal rises from >50 m to 14 m with 3-5 m drops.
features: Strong tidal flow over shallow ridge between Gribba Point and Brisons; Brisons ~1.6 km SW of cape
notes: No evidence of anyone fishing from the Brisons rocks themselves. Divernet: 1 kn surface stream on Cape Cornwall Bank with faster bottom flow and shear ~15 m on the day dived. Pollack group seen on Bann Shoal. Offshore banks are not shore marks.
